long_biography.plain_text:
After service in the US Navy, Jim Glidewell trained in dental technology at Orange Coast College and opened his own laboratory in California in 1970. Working initially from a kitchen table, he built a national restorative-dentistry business by standardising production and bringing laboratory services, materials research and device manufacturing into one private company.

Glidewell pushed the business from analogue craftwork towards CAD/CAM design, zirconia restorations, implants, in-office milling and automated manufacturing. The company appointed Stephenie Goddard chief executive in 2022, while he remained president and board chairman. Glidewell is its founder and reported owner, but its laboratories, intellectual property, revenue, equipment and property portfolio are corporate assets rather than his personal holdings.
long_biography.html:
After service in the US Navy, Jim Glidewell trained in dental technology at Orange Coast College and opened his own laboratory in California in 1970. Working initially from a kitchen table, he built a national restorative-dentistry business by standardising production and bringing laboratory services, materials research and device manufacturing into one private company.

Glidewell pushed the business from analogue craftwork towards CAD/CAM design, zirconia restorations, implants, in-office milling and automated manufacturing. The company appointed Stephenie Goddard chief executive in 2022, while he remained president and board chairman. Glidewell is its founder and reported owner, but its laboratories, intellectual property, revenue, equipment and property portfolio are corporate assets rather than his personal holdings.
